scenes.heading: the cafe board
scenes.narration: What if the buttons forgot you between clicks? This tiny toolbox redraws the screen for you each frame. It acts like a cafe board that's wiped clean. Come follow one click with me.

scenes.heading: the cafe counter
scenes.narration: You tap at the cafe counter. The demo app, the loop running it, feeds click inward and lists widgets again. Inside the ui context, the desk tracking state, holds hover and focus.

scenes.heading: the back wall
scenes.narration: The back wall rewrites boxes for you. Your built in controls, the widget kit, rebuild buttons and return presses. That fixed memory, the notebook, stores notes without allocation.

scenes.heading: the front window
scenes.narration: Pixels appear at the front window for you. The host renderer, the screen painter you supply, paints queued rectangles and text.

scenes.heading: the lunch rush
scenes.narration: During the lunch rush you click the OK box. The demo app feeds the input as a pressed mouse. Next the ui context with built in controls declares the widgets as one OK button. It queues the draws in fixed memory as gray box plus text and reports the press as true, then sends the queue onward. The host renderer draws the rects as pixels and shows the frame with lit OK.

scenes.heading: the whole trip
scenes.narration: That whole trip moves your click from demo app through ui context and built in controls into fixed memory to host renderer as lit OK. Forgetting each frame keeps your buttons tiny and fresh.
